scope_notes: Pilot running on 25 traffic light intersections along the Outer Ring Road corridor in Bangalore (out of 353 total city intersections).
Deployed smart bin sensors & vehicle GPS tracking across Sector 1 to Sector 10 in Gandhinagar to close the MSW collection gap.
field_notes: Uncollected daily waste gap dropped dramatically from 30 MT/day baseline down to 6 MT/day during the 45-day trial period.

scope_notes: 30-day pilot facility established at Sector 30 waste dump site in Gandhinagar featuring automated segregation and rapid composting.
field_notes: MSW processing & recycling volume jumped from 15 MT/day (2017-18 baseline) to 65 MT/day, processing 68% of Gandhinagar's total generated waste.
